early.name: Trophy Collector

mid.name: Heroic Aura
mid.annotation: Paige already buffs allies. If no teammate has it, this adds team bullet resist and a speed button

mid.name: Greater Expansion
mid.annotation: Bigger dragon trail, bigger Read circle, longer cast range on everything

late.name: Divine Barrier
late.annotation: Cleanse plus barrier on your carry. Answer to Pocket ult or a big burst on a teammate

late.name: Superior Duration
late.annotation: Longer burning trail, longer root, longer barrier. Everything you do lasts longer

late.name: Refresher
late.annotation: Resets everything. Two Rallying Charges in one big fight

late.name: Boundless Spirit
late.annotation: Raw spirit power. Dragons and ult knights hit much harder

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: Anti heal plus a burn on everyone your dragon and Read hit hard

late.name: Escalating Exposure
late.annotation: Upgrade Mystic Vulnerability. Each spirit hit stacks more damage on them

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Upgrade Superior Cooldown. Abilities and items both come back faster
